result.brief: 提出 GameWeaver 扩散框架，用 tipxel 几何潜变量与双流 Transformer 实现相机轨迹估计、轨迹条件视频生成与联合视频-相机生成，可自动产出配对视频-相机数据。
result.reason: Abstract describes a diffusion Transformer generating video with camera trajectories (tipxel geometry latents), i.e., action/camera-conditioned video world modeling with a shared VAE latent representation.
